## Podcasts without Spotify
- Podcasts never need a Spotify login: search, show pages, playing, following and new episodes all come from the public Apple Podcasts directory and each show's own feed
- **Show only on Spotify?** Under **Podcasts & Shows** in the search, and when nothing is found, a **Search on Spotify** button opens Spotify's own search for the words, no login in Streyn needed
- With Spotify connected, Spotify-only shows still appear right in the results (from 1.33.1)

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
